title: Introduce Personalisation Studio
summary: Night Roster now has a dedicated Me and Our Shift studio for polished personal identity, accessibility preferences and a richer shared shift brand without altering clinical meaning.
changes: Account now includes a dedicated Me and Our Shift Personalisation Studio with live identity previews instead of scattered cosmetic settings.
Members can personalise their avatar style, preferred name, professional title, accent, text size, motion and greeting while verified roster identity and clinical colours remain protected.
The whole shift can share one name, optional tagline, symbol, accent and private team picture across Night and Team Chat.
Shift images are restricted to authorised shift members, personal photos remain private to their owner, and generated identity fallbacks keep the app polished without requiring uploads.
